text:
Maya (PM): kicking off a short thread to align on Hosted API priorities for next quarter. top-level asks: reduce chat p95 latency, improve embeddings stability for enterprise customers, and finalize rerank beta launch criteria. who wants to take initial notes?

Liam (Eng): I can take notes. quick Q: do we keep latency as a hard OKR or target a mix of latency + cost?

Maya (PM): mix. primary OKR: p95 latency improvement (hosted chat) by 20% for 1k+ token flows. secondary: reduce token cost by 10% via batching/quantization suggestions.

Sofia (ML): for embeddings, enterprise reported drift on multi-lingual sets. propose embedding-compat tests + weekly evals. need dataset from Eva for top 5 customers.

Eva (Customer Success): sending sample sets today. main ask: deterministic-ish embeddings for search; customers want stability across minor model bumps.

Liam (Eng): re: rerank beta — what's minimum launch scope? we have two modes: server-side rerank endpoint and client-side score assist. Launch criteria idea below.

Maya (PM): paste the proposed launch checklist so we can iterate.

Liam (Eng): ```
Rerank beta launch checklist:
- API stable for 95% of synthetic traffic (no 5xx)
- Latency p90 < 200ms for 10-item rerank on n1-standard
- SDK examples (python/js) + sample dataset
- Billing + quota knobs in Console (beta flags)
- Security review complete (data flow doc + e2e test)
- Beta customer signed and onboarding docs ready
```

Sofia (ML): also add evaluation metric: NDCG@10 >= baseline model on customer workload and no >5% regression on recall across language buckets.

Maya (PM): good. prioritize: 1) chat latency improvements 2) embedding stability + eval infra 3) rerank beta launch 4) SDK ergonomics and docs. any objections?

Arjun (SRE): resource note: reducing p95 by 20% may require kernel-level serving changes + a small fleet increase during rollout. need cost approval from finance for a short-term bump.

Maya (PM): flagged for finance. I'll include an ask in the QBR deck.

Eva (Customer Success): customer-driven negotiation note: one customer is willing to pay for a dedicated embedding namespace if we guarantee stability SLAs. that could get us to fund the embedding infra work.

Sofia (ML): perfect — that means we can scope embedding infra as a gated enterprise feature with clear acceptance criteria: deterministic hashing + version pinning and migration plan.

Liam (Eng): for chat latency improvement, quick experimental plan:
- short-term (2 weeks): adaptive batching tweaks + reduce cold-starts (cache warmed models)
- mid-term (6-8 weeks): KV-cache optimizations + improved attention kernel selection heuristics
- measure: synthetic latency tests + sampled production shadow traffic

Maya (PM): acceptable. set a cutover plan with feature flags and rollback triggers. define SLOs and an automated canary gate.

Arjun (SRE): canary gate details: if error rate > 0.5% or p95 increases by 5% relative to baseline, auto rollback. devops-bot will create the canary pipeline and alerting.

devops-bot: Created pipeline: hosted-api-latency-canary. Alerts -> #incidents if triggered.

Liam (Eng): question about scope negotiation: if the dedicated embeddings ask lands, do we treat it as a paid add-on (Private/Dedicated) or offer as hosted enterprise tier?

Maya (PM): prefer enterprise add-on first to defray costs, but offer migration path to Dedicated later. we'll confirm pricing with finance.

Eva (Customer Success): i'll surface the add-on proposal in renewals for the big customer — they'll want SLA language and a migration discount.

Sofia (ML): one more: embeddings regression alerts — propose per-customer baselines + drift detector. low-effort prototype in 3 weeks.

Maya (PM): assign owners and next steps:
- Chat latency plan owner: Liam (Eng)
- Embeddings stability + eval infra: Sofia (ML) + Eva (CS)
- Rerank beta launch: Liam + Maya
- Canaries + alerting: Arjun (SRE)

Maya (PM): deliverables for next sync (2 weeks): short PRD for chat optimizations, initial embedding eval dataset, rerank beta checklist with responsible engineers, and cost impact estimate.

Liam (Eng): noted. I'll drop initial PRD by Tue.

Sofia (ML): will share dataset spec and quick prototype results in 2 weeks.

Eva (Customer Success): will collect customer datasets and draft SLA asks.

Arjun (SRE): I'll wire up canary pipeline and share runbook.

Maya (PM): thanks all. quick vote: prioritize chat latency experiments as Q1 sprint 0. react with :+1: to confirm.

Liam (Eng): :+1: 

Sofia (ML): :+1: 

Arjun (SRE): :+1: 

Eva (Customer Success): :+1: 

Maya (PM): great — closing thread. I'll create the OKR ticket and link this thread.
